Comma-separated provider codes, e.g. twint or visa,mastercard. Leave empty to offer everything the account allows. Lets one gateway serve several tiles: name a second Payment Gateway Account after the same provider and restrict it here, and the shopper gets a TWINT tile and a card tile that both settle through it. Ignored by gateways that cannot filter.
fields.label: Restrict Payment Methods

fields.description: Show the payment page inside the checkout instead of sending the shopper away. Suits card entry, which is a form. Leave off for methods that hand over to an app — TWINT switches to the phone, and it cannot do that from inside a frame.
